ask: Your video's description goes to a stranger's machine, which also sees the video it creates, without knowing who you are. Create your images and videos through the public network?
closed_off: No video model can compute right now, here or on your online machines. A machine on the public network could create it if your creations could go to strangers (“Have my conversations computed by strangers”, in Settings, This machine, Sharing computing power); or install a model in “Images and videos”.
closed_mine_only: No video model can compute right now, here or on your online machines. A machine on the public network could create it, but this conversation stays on your machines (“On my machines only”, in Permissions under the message box).
closed_attachments: No video model can compute right now, here or on your online machines. A machine on the public network could create it, but an attached image never goes to a stranger (and a video can't start from an image yet): ask for it without an attached image.
closed_refused: No video model can compute right now, here or on your online machines. A machine on the public network could create it, with your consent (“Create my images and videos through the public network”, in Settings, This machine, Sharing computing power); or install a model in “Images and videos”.
nobody: No video model can compute right now, here, on your online machines, or on the public network: install one in “Images and videos”, or try again in a moment.
too_big: This video is too large for a machine on the public network (832 × 480 pixels and 5 seconds at most): choose a smaller format or a shorter length.
withdrawn: your videos no longer go through the public network (Settings, or “On my machines only”)
nobody_now: no machine on the public network can create this video right now
failed: no machine on the public network could create it ({error})
refused_content: This video won't go to the public network: its filter refuses the description (a minor, a real person or violence, in a sexual or nude context). Neither the public network nor AIODOS creates this kind of video, and nothing was sent to a stranger. If your request had nothing of the sort, rephrase it: the filter relies on certain words.
refused_filter: the public network's filter refuses this description: nothing was sent to a stranger
refused_remote: the machine on the public network refuses this description: its filter judges it forbidden
only_restricted: No video model can compute right now, here or on your online machines. The public network could only do it with a model under a restrictive license ({models}): choose it yourself in the model menu, after reading its license.
